fail_closed_rules: Withdrawn Post and Deferred records are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Sold Post without consideration is not assigned a price.
Seller top-up during a rent-free period is not represented as tenant-paid rent.
Holding-over occupation, expired leases and proposed but unexecuted new leases are not silently regularised.
Outstanding rent reviews, future reviews and mutual options are not resolved.
Overage and seller-cost provisions are not converted into price or value.
Unregistered land, title gaps and adopted-highway issues are preserved without assumed cure.
Gross or headline rent is not converted into net operating income.
Planning and redevelopment opportunities are not represented as consented or valued outcomes.
Active company status, registered office and charges do not imply covenant strength or property-level performance.
Legal-pack EPC, title and tenancy details are not filled by inference.
No business or parcel row was written by the maintenance/control slot.
